[short] skip

# bolero list with path to directory should work

# populate go.sum
bolero get

env BOLERO_MODULE=off
bolero list -f '{{.ImportPath}}' $BOLERO_ROOT/src/math
stdout ^math$

env BOLERO_MODULE=on
bolero list -f '{{.ImportPath}}' $BOLERO_ROOT/src/math
stdout ^math$
bolero list -f '{{.ImportPath}}' .
stdout ^x$

bolero mod download rsc.io/quote@v1.5.2
bolero list -f '{{.ImportPath}}' $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/rsc.io/quote@v1.5.2
stdout '^rsc.io/quote$'
bolero list -f '{{.ImportPath}}' $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/rsc.io/sampler@v1.3.0
stdout '^rsc.io/sampler$'
bolero get rsc.io/sampler@v1.3.1
bolero list -f '{{.ImportPath}}' $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/rsc.io/sampler@v1.3.1
stdout '^rsc.io/sampler$'
! bolero list -f '{{.ImportPath}}' $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/rsc.io/sampler@v1.3.0
stderr 'outside main module or its selected dependencies'

-- go.mod --
module x
require rsc.io/quote v1.5.2
